title: fix: keep agents serving when an MCP server fails
author: voodoohop
pr_body_excerpt:
Follow-ups from the agent MCP outage.

**One bad MCP server 502s the whole agent.** `loadMcpTools` threw and `createAgent()` sits outside any try/catch, so a 404/405 from any server failed every request. This is live: published agent `19e9460d` points at `https://victor-websearch.hf.space/gradio_api/mcp/sse` — POST returns 405 (it is an SSE endpoint; the runtime speaks Streamable HTTP), so that agent returns 502 on every call.

- Isolates each server: a failing one loses its tools, the agent still answers.
- Adds `MCP_SERVER_LOADED` / `MCP_SERVER_FAILED` logs. `handlePromptAgentRequest` returns a Response instead of throwing, so Hono's `onError` never fires and nothing reaches `error_event` — this route emits no telemetry at all, and these logs are the only signal a server dropped out.
- Makes the built-in MCP url env-overridable (`POLLINATIONS_MCP_URL`), matching the existing `genBaseUrl`/`GEN_BASE_URL` pattern, so the endpoint can move without a code change.

**Note on the redirect test:** it keeps its security assertion — credentials never reach the redirect target, which `redirect: "manual"` guarantees independently of failure handling — and now also asserts the agent keeps serving instead of returning 502. Failure semantics are what this PR intentionally changes.

Not included: real telemetry for this route needs the Hono context plumbed into the service, which is bigger than this change.

Checks: `npx vitest run test/prompt-agent-runtime.test.ts` — 21 passed.

gist.headline: One bad server, ignored
gist.blurb: An agent no longer falls into the compost heap because one MCP server has a bad URL. The flaky server drops its tool basket; the rest of the agent keeps working.
gist.summary: Agent runtime now isolates MCP server loading failures, so a 404, 405, or 502 from one configured server no longer makes createAgent() fail and return 502 for the whole agent; the built-in MCP endpoint is also configurable through POLLINATIONS_MCP_URL.
gist.impact: Published agents with a broken or incompatible MCP endpoint, such as an SSE URL contacted as Streamable HTTP, will keep answering with their remaining tools instead of failing every request.
gist.visual_concept: Depict an agent tool garden where one little MCP tool shed is closed with a harmless 405 sign while the other healthy code-plants continue feeding a cozy retro terminal. Polli, wearing a tiny mechanic tool belt, calmly reroutes a watering hose around the closed shed; a cheerful CRT monitor robot keeps the agent terminal online, showing that one failed connection no longer stops the whole system.
